errors.slope-term-not-coefficient: Gives the term rather than the coefficient

errors.quad-sign-roots: Gets the signs of both roots wrong
errors.inv-sign-flip: Changes signs instead of undoing the operations
errors.count-wrong-base: Uses the number of positions as the number of choices

errors.comb-order-counted: Counts ordered selections when order does not matter
errors.sim-swapped: Swaps the values of x and y
errors.log-diff-inside: Thinks log a − log b = log(a − b)

errors.gr-match-degree: Confuses linear, quadratic and cubic shapes
errors.perp-not-reciprocal: Changes the sign but does not take the reciprocal
errors.ind-zero-undefined: Thinks a zero exponent is undefined
